name: Coaptite pivotal
question: Is urethral calcium hydroxylapatite noninferior to bovine dermal collagen for stress urinary incontinence caused by intrinsic sphincter deficiency in women without urethral hypermobility?

design.population: Women at least 18 years old with stress urinary incontinence due to intrinsic sphincter deficiency, straining urethral angle of 35° or less, bladder capacity greater than 250 mL without detrusor instability, negative urine culture, and no prior urethral bulking.
design.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, pp 877-878; Results, p 878

verdictNote: Primary noninferiority met; 12-month efficacy analysis included 231/296 treated women.
takeaway: Calcium hydroxylapatite (Coaptite) met the prespecified noninferiority criterion versus bovine dermal collagen (Contigen) for 12-month Stamey-grade improvement in women with intrinsic sphincter deficiency; among 231 evaluable women, improvement occurred in 83/131 (63.4%) versus 57/100 (57.0%; P = 0.34).

reports.label: Pivotal comparative trial
reports.citation: Mayer RD, Dmochowski RR, Appell RA, et al. "Multicenter Prospective Randomized 52-Week Trial of Calcium Hydroxylapatite Versus Bovine Dermal Collagen for Treatment of Stress Urinary Incontinence." *Urology.* 2007;69(5):876-880. doi:10.1016/j.urology.2007.01.050
reports.followUp: 12 months after initial injection; complete-case efficacy data for 231/296 treated women
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 877

results.measure: At least one Stamey-grade improvement at 12 months, evaluable patients with baseline and 12-month scores
results.note: The prespecified 95% confidence interval criterion used a 15% bound and anticipated 70% collagen response; the paper states noninferiority was met but does not print the observed interval. P = 0.34 compares groups.
results.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 877; Efficacy, p 878

results.measure: At least one Stamey-grade improvement at 12 months, intent-to-treat analysis with last observation carried forward
results.note: The paper gives rounded percentages without arm counts for this analysis.
The paper does not provide arm-specific counts for this endpoint.

results.measure: At least 50% decline in 24-hour pad weight at 12 months
results.note: The paper does not provide arm-specific counts for this endpoint.

harms.label: Transient urinary retention
harms.note: No permanent retention occurred; the paper reports percentages without patient counts.

harms.label: Treatment-related serious local erosion or tissue dissection
harms.locator: Full text, Safety, p 878; Comment, p 879
harms.note: One vaginal-wall erosion led to a subsequent suburethral sling; the other event was trigonal submucosal dissection without intervention.

harms.label: Systemic adverse events or chronic persistent urinary tract infection
harms.locator: Full text, Abstract, Results, p 876; Safety, p 878
harms.note: Neither was reported in either arm.

harms.label: Any serious adverse event
harms.note: 23 patients experienced 33 serious events; only two events, both in the CaHA arm, were considered treatment related.

harms.label: Post-treatment urge incontinence
harms.note: P < 0.05; the paper does not give patient counts.

delivery.label: Injection protocol
delivery.value: Injection by experienced investigators at the bladder neck to achieve visual coaptation; anesthesia and transurethral or periurethral route at investigator discretion; up to five injections in the first six months.
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 877

delivery.label: Initial injection route
delivery.note: Periurethral injection was used in 13/158 (8.2%) CaHA patients and 15/138 (10.9%) collagen patients.

delivery.label: Single-session treatment during study
delivery.locator: Full text, Abstract, Results, p 876; Efficacy, p 878; Conclusions, p 879
delivery.note: P = 0.034 in the abstract and conclusion; rounded to P = 0.03 in the efficacy text.

delivery.label: Mean total injected volume over study
delivery.locator: Full text, Abstract, Results, p 876; Efficacy, p 879
delivery.note: P < 0.0001 for total volume over the study course.
